description: From 11:00 the tank is heated for the 15:00 and 17:00 to 19:00 showers: 55 C when the solar forecast for today is 10 kWh or more (stores free solar heat), otherwise 50 C. From 19:30 it holds 45 C overnight, or 42 C when tomorrow's solar forecast is 10 kWh or more. Replaces the two PV based hot water automations (switched off, not deleted).

data.temperature: {% set today = states('sensor.energy_production_today') | float(0) %}{% set tomorrow = states('sensor.energy_production_tomorrow') | float(0) %}{% if trigger.id == 'heat' or (trigger.id == 'restore' and 11 <= now().hour < 20) %}{{ 55 if today >= 10 else 50 }}{% else %}{{ 42 if tomorrow >= 10 else 45 }}{% endif %}
